item.title: The Artificial State: Billionaires Misread Sci‑Fi
item.description: Explore how Musk, Altman and Bezos reinterpret sci‑fi as a roadmap for immortality, space colonization and AI, discarding the works’ moral warnings.

item.title: Falcon 9 Stage Crashes Into Moon, Leaving Crater
item.description: SpaceX’s Falcon 9 second stage hit the Moon, forming a crater. KARI’s Danuri orbiter captured images, while telescopes detected sodium and lithium plumes.

item.title: Perseverance Rover Sets New Mars Distance Record
item.description: Perseverance rover will break Opportunity’s 45‑km Mars travel record next week, marking a new milestone for robotic exploration for humanity.

item.title: Visible-Light Image Reveals Century-Old Plasma Vortices
item.description: A breakthrough visible‑light photograph finally visualizes tiny plasma vortices, confirming a century‑old prediction and reshaping solar physics.

item.title: Starship 13th Test Delayed, Skyroot Vikram‑1 Soars
item.description: SpaceX’s 13th Starship test faces a last‑second abort and new launch date, while India’s Skyroot celebrates Vikram‑1’s successful 280‑mile orbit.

item.title: Northrop Grumman’s MRV & MEPs Reach Geosynchronous Orbit
item.description: Northrop Grumman’s MRV and three MEPs launched on SpaceX’s Falcon 9, kicking off a decade‑long mission to service geosynchronous satellites in orbit.
